description: This Java class defines a UserMapper responsible for converting between User DTOs and UserEntity objects within a Spring application, utilizing BeanUtils for copying properties and a nested BankAccountMapper for handling associated bank account data.

classes.name: UserMapper
classes.description: A mapper class for converting between User DTO and UserEntity objects.

methods.name: convertToEntity
methods.description: Converts a User DTO to a UserEntity, copying properties and transforming bank account data.

methods.name: convertToDto
methods.description: Converts a UserEntity to a User DTO, copying properties and transforming bank account data.
